class AnnouncementBarRotator extends HTMLElement{connectedCallback(){this.track=this.querySelector("[data-track]"),this.slides=Array.from(this.querySelectorAll("[data-slide]")),this.slideCount=this.slides.length,this.index=0,this.timer=null,this.paused=!1,this.reducedMotion=window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches,this.interval=(parseInt(this.dataset.interval,10)||5)*1e3,this.duration=parseInt(this.dataset.duration,10)||500,this.pauseOnHover=this.dataset.pauseOnHover!=="false",this.direction=this.dataset.direction||"",this.track&&(this.track.style.transition=`transform ${this.duration}ms ease-in-out`),this.updateTransform(),this.bindEvents(),this.slideCount>1&&!this.reducedMotion&&this.startTimer()}disconnectedCallback(){this.stopTimer(),this.unbindEvents()}bindEvents(){this.onMouseEnter=()=>{this.pauseOnHover&&this.pause()},this.onMouseLeave=()=>{this.pauseOnHover&&!this.paused&&this.startTimer()},this.onBlockSelect=event=>{const slide=event.target.closest("[data-slide]");!slide||!this.contains(slide)||(this.goToSlide(slide),this.pause())},this.onBlockDeselect=()=>{!this.reducedMotion&&this.slideCount>1&&(this.paused=!1,this.startTimer())},this.pauseOnHover&&(this.addEventListener("mouseenter",this.onMouseEnter),this.addEventListener("mouseleave",this.onMouseLeave)),document.addEventListener("shopify:block:select",this.onBlockSelect),document.addEventListener("shopify:block:deselect",this.onBlockDeselect)}unbindEvents(){this.pauseOnHover&&(this.removeEventListener("mouseenter",this.onMouseEnter),this.removeEventListener("mouseleave",this.onMouseLeave)),document.removeEventListener("shopify:block:select",this.onBlockSelect),document.removeEventListener("shopify:block:deselect",this.onBlockDeselect)}startTimer(){this.stopTimer(),this.timer=window.setInterval(()=>this.advance(),this.interval)}stopTimer(){this.timer&&(window.clearInterval(this.timer),this.timer=null)}pause(){this.paused=!0,this.stopTimer()}advance(){this.direction==="reverse"?this.index=(this.index-1+this.slideCount)%this.slideCount:this.index=(this.index+1)%this.slideCount,this.updateTransform()}updateTransform(){this.track&&(this.track.style.transform=`translateX(-${this.index*100}%)`)}goToSlide(slideEl){const slideIndex=this.slides.indexOf(slideEl);slideIndex!==-1&&(this.index=slideIndex,this.updateTransform())}}customElements.get("announcement-bar-rotator")||customElements.define("announcement-bar-rotator",AnnouncementBarRotator);
